Erus Academy — Full LMS Platform with Web, iOS & Android Apps

Erus Academy

the challenge

Erus Academy needed a complete LMS platform to deliver video courses, quizzes, and learning material across web and mobile.

our approach

Architected a unified LMS backend with REST APIs supporting the web portal alongside cross-platform iOS and Android mobile apps.

what we built

Web LMS portal, native iOS application, native Android application, course management system, and student progress tracking.

the outcome

Deployed LMS platform across web, Google Play Store, and Apple App Store.
